mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 5% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, the combination signals a potential overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 300,000 and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real final sales (RSAFS) relative to GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS/GDPC1 is high and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is declining and unemployment (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, the hypothesis fails.
